name: Kanban
attribution: After Toyota's kanban; boards for knowledge work are traditional

claims.claim: Items placed inside the same bounded region are perceived as belonging together, even against other grouping cues, so labelled zones make category membership readable at a glance.
claims.construct: the Gestalt principle of common region (perceptual grouping)

grounding.helps: when work moves through stages and seeing what is in progress matters more than the plan; the preset adds no claim beyond the zones
grounding.backfires: when "doing" fills up without a limit, or moving cards across the board replaces finishing them
